name: @lastest/plugin-qa-agent
description: WIP — QA Agent migration, in flight. The domain layer has moved and is live: the discovery crawl, the explorer swarm and login resolution, converted off raw CDP onto core-issued pages and imported by src/server/actions/qa-agent.ts through @lastest/plugin-qa-agent/domain/*. Still to come: the manifest, the host port, the actions, the UI, and the two tables in src/schema.planned.ts. No typecheck script on purpose — DrivablePage resolves to unknown without @lastest/core-browser in the program, which no plugin may import; the app's own tsc covers these files. RFC §7.4 makes this file the reviewable unit, so it lists only what exists. See docs/architecture/core-plugin-refactor.md.
